description:
A Hotmart é uma empresa global de tecnologia, líder em negócios digitais e protagonista na Creator Economy (Economia dos Criadores de Conteúdo). Com sede nos Países Baixos, nosso time de Troopers - forma como carinhosamente chamamos nossos colaboradores (as) - está espalhado por sete países.

Nosso jeito de trabalhar é desenvolver talentos enquanto geramos impacto positivo no mundo. Para isso, usamos a tecnologia para possibilitar que pessoas transformem seu conhecimento em negócios de sucesso e trabalhamos com Autonomia, Liberdade e “Love”, para sempre lembrarmos de nutrir relações sinceras e nos importar com as pessoas à nossa volta.

Formamos um ecossistema multiplataforma que impulsiona o mercado da Creator Economy e gera impacto global, cumprindo nossa missão de encorajar as pessoas a compartilharem seus conhecimentos para ganharem o mundo ao criar, vender e escalar seu negócio digital.

Posição disponível para trabalhar nos escritórios de BH ou SP.

Missão

SDR é sigla para Sales Development Representative. Esse profissional é o responsável pela qualificação de leads na etapa de pré-venda. Tem a função de fazer diagnóstico e prospecção de clientes com o objetivo de entender se ele é ou não um potencial de acordo com as regras de negócio da empresa, e assim, passar as oportunidades mais qualificadas para os Closers darem continuidade na negociação.

Requisitos:

  • Comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Conhecimento em vendas Inside Sales (desejável);
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de prospecção e venda (SPIN, GPCT);
  • Conhecimento em prospecção ativa (outbound, desejável);
  • Noções em Google Drive e suas ferramentas;
  • Conhecimento de Pacote Office;
  • Noção em planilhas (gráficos e levantamento de dados);
  • Noções de gestão de projetos ágeis;
  • Noção de ferramentas de dashboards.

Atividades

  • Atuar de forma ativa na prospecção de novos clientes e na conexão com esses prospects e clientes da base que se qualifiquem ao processo Hotmart;
  • Pesquisar sobre o negócio e maturidade do lead para identificar potencial e preparar a melhor abordagem ao Cliente da Base e Novos Clientes;
  • Fazer o primeiro contato com novos clientes e apresentar a proposta de valor da Hotmart, bem como gerar valor na conversa com o próximo agente do processo, o Closer;
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar cadências de prospecção e nutrição, acompanhar as leads e fazer follow-ups que despertem interesse;
  • Mapear o cenário e identificar dores e necessidades dos Novos Clientes, a fim de encontrar match entre as soluções Hotmart e os planos de negócio do produtor digital;
  • Gerar valor na conversa com especialista (Closer) e agendar uma reunião virtual entre Closer e cliente. Acompanhar o andamento dessa agenda e, se necessário, reagenda-la;
  • Participar de eventos a fim de gerar oportunidades comerciais e relacionamento com possíveis clientes;
  • Contribuir na construção de processos e projetos que auxiliem na melhoria da performance do time, e atuar em parceria com os demais setores da empresa buscando oportunidades de trabalhar em sinergia.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico com cobertura nacional, sem custo para o colaborador e com coparticipação para cônjuge e dependentes;
  • Vale refeição/alimentação (Flash - bandeira Visa);
  • Benefício flexível (Flash Multibenefícios - bandeira Visa), podendo ser destinado à alimentação, refeição, mobilidade (aplicativos de transporte, combustível, transporte público em SP), cultura, saúde e educação;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Wellhub;
  • Auxílio creche para filhos de até cinco anos;
  • Budget de educação: valor destinado aos investimentos relacionados à sua educação, de forma a contribuir para desenvolver e potencializar suas competências;
  • Incentivo ao aprendizado de idiomas por meio de plataforma online;
  • Baby On Board: benefício oferecido para as pessoas que estão se preparando para a maternidade e paternidade;
  • Licença maternidade estendida (180 dias);
  • Licença Paternidade estendida (30 dias);
  • Conexa Saúde: acesso online gratuito a profissionais da área da saúde - Nutricionista e Psicólogo;
  • Participação anual nos lucros e resultados da companhia (PLR);
  • Hotmart Recharge: bônus de 30% do salário bruto mensal, pago após cumprir o período aquisitivo de férias de 30 dias.

Fazer parte do nosso time, é acordar todos os dias com a certeza de que o mundo é pequeno para o tamanho do impacto que podemos gerar. Vem pra Hotmart e apaixone-se por transformar: você, sua carreira, o mundo!

Job description

Inovação é o que nos move. A Cogna é uma das maiores organizações de educação no mundo e pioneira no Brasil. Temos o objetivo de “impulsionar as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si”. Com mais de 50 anos de tradição, atualmente somos uma das maiores empresas do setor de educação do mundo, temos um modelo de negócio amplo e com muitas oportunidades de crescimento. Possibilitamos produtos e serviços educacionais que vão desde a jornada de aprendizado infantil até à terceira idade.

#AquiéCogna e temos em nosso DNA a evolução e o dinamismo de uma jovem startup, mas com a estrutura de uma grande empresa com mais de 70 marcas. Por aqui, agimos pensando no sucesso do aluno. Temos paixão por educar e valorizamos as pessoas. Somos responsáveis por fazer acontecer, sempre gerando valor sustentável e juntos, podemos mais. Nós somos a Cogna!

Main responsibilities

Como Pessoa Consultora Comercial você vai:

  • Executar ativações comerciais em empresas, órgãos públicos, escolas e eventos em geral para promoção e divulgação da marca com foco em captação;
  • Ser responsável pela gestão do funil de vendas;

  • Ser responsável pela gestão dos indicadores comerciais;
  • Realizar prospecção de clientes;
  • Atender com foco na experiência do aluno/candidato;
  • Terá atuação interna e externa.

Requirements and skills

É importante que você tenha:

  • Ensino Superior Completo ou cursando;
  • Pacote Office básico;
  • Experiência na área comercial, preferencialmente com vendas externas;
  • Desejável veículo próprio e CNH.

Additional information

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.
  • Seguro de Vida: Este benefício é compulsório, a todos os colaboradores CLT, sem custo, e estão inclusos na apólice de seguro, a partir da sua data de admissão.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Join to apply for the Engineering Manager, MAAS role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include leading public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across sectors. We have a global, distributed team of over 1200 colleagues in more than 80 countries, with few office-based roles. Teams meet periodically in person at locations worldwide to align on strategy and execution.

We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to expand the MAAS team. Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide a top-tier solution for building and managing private bare-metal infrastructure, offering a cloud-style on-demand API for physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We seek engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership, with deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage, and data center networking.

MAAS components cover the entire software stack: from hardware detection and provisioning to the web interface, API, and CLI. Successful engineers are fluent across these layers and can anticipate the impacts of design choices in a complex distributed system.

At Canonical, you need a solid technical background, but your primary responsibility is to lead an effective team and develop your colleagues. You will help them grow, perform outstanding work, find personal and professional satisfaction, and collaborate effectively. Technical leadership and a background in software engineering are prerequisites. You will lead, challenge, and develop engineers, influence company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work on strategy and execution. You will also collaborate with other engineering teams, such as cloud-init, LXD, and cloud services.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate leadership, deep Linux knowledge, and the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.

Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA or the Americas.

The role involves:

  1. Leading a distributed engineering team in your time zone
  2. Talent development through coaching, mentoring, and career planning
  3. Managing expectations with other teams, management, and stakeholders
  4. Promoting modern software development practices
  5. Participating in code and architecture reviews
  6. Engaging with broader teams, open source community, and partners
  7. Traveling for global events (4-6 weeks per year)

We seek candidates with:

  1. Strong academic background and a degree in a technical field
  2. Confidence in communication and feedback exchange
  3. A record of exceeding expectations
  4. Leadership and mentorship skills
  5. Passion for technology and personal projects
  6. Work ethic and confidence working with motivated colleagues
  7. Excellent English communication skills
  8. Experience with Linux (Debian/Ubuntu preferred)
  9. Interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, accountability
  10. Appreciation for diversity and multicultural work environments
  11. Self-motivation and thoughtfulness
  12. Result-oriented mindset and ability to meet commitments
  13. Willingness to travel internationally twice a year
  14. Understanding of modern Linux cloud technologies (networking, storage, containers, K8s)
  15. Programming experience in Python and Go
  16. Interest in developing and growing people

Nice-to-have skills include experience with Typescript and modern web frameworks.

A NB Máquinas é uma das mais importantes indústrias do Agronegócio brasileiro e mundial. Com seu foco na linha de implementos agrícolas forrageiros, a NB se tornou um grupo com duas marcas mundialmente conhecidas: JF e Nogueira, fornecendo equipamentos para todo o território brasileiro e para mais de 50 países.

História:

Em 2013 as duas maiores e tradicionais empresas no mercado de máquinas para forragem do Brasil, a JF e a Nogueira se fundem formando um dos maiores grupos de implementos forrageiros do mundo, a NB Máquinas. Com essa união, parceiros e clientes continuam tendo a disposição os atendimentos distintos das marcas JF e Nogueira, porém ambas com muito mais força em qualidade, engenharia, desenvolvimento de produtos e soluções agrícolas.

Com uma ampla linha de produtos, nossas marcas atuam nos segmentos de distribuidores de calcário e fertilizante, plataformas recolhedoras, colhedoras de forragem, vagões misturadores, desintegradores, ensiladeiras, picadoras, vagões forrageiros, enfardadeiras, segadeiras, enleiradores e espalhadores além de embutidoras e extratoras de grãos para silo bolsa.

A soma de alto investimento em tecnologia, alinhado a uma equipe tecnicamente qualificada com profissionais comprometidos com o desenvolvimento de novos produtos, a NB Máquinas proporciona ao mercado agropecuário equipamentos de altíssima qualidade e preços competitivos, solucionando problemas do campo e cada vez mais proporcionando melhores rendimentos e facilidade para o produtor.

Nosso sucesso é o reflexo da satisfação do produtor, ao perceber que com as soluções apresentadas pelas maiores marcas do mercado forrageiro, a JF Máquinas e a Nogueira Máquinas, conseguimos aumentar a qualidade e produtividade no campo.

We strive to be a continuous, responsible contributor to the mobile industry and a great place to work. We’ll look for ways to integrate mobile solutions to apps, and to make completing mobile integration work easier, faster, and safer for everyone. Together with App Publishers and SDK vendors, we are working to solve the biggest pains and accelerate the adoption, use, and enjoyment of mobile applications for everyone. Join our team!

Service Delivery Engineer for Latin America

About The Position

We are hiring an experienced Service Delivery Engineer for Latin America.

You will provide resolutions for technical and product issues while communicating and building trust and relationships with our customers.

Responsibilities

  1. Working closely with the local sales team to help educate customers about the Appdome platform.
  2. Onboard new customers in the assigned segment, including initial customer engagement and identification of desired outcomes.
  3. Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships.
  4. Deliver and own the technical customer experience with Appdome.
  5. Own, troubleshoot, and solve customer technical issues.
  6. Identify cases that require escalation (either technically or strategically).
  7. Contribute to case deflection initiatives, automation, and other digital self-help assets to improve customer and engineer experience.
  8. Update our internal databases with information about technical issues and useful discussions with customers.
  9. Identify, organize and perform customer trainings.
  10. Inform customers about new features and functionalities.
  11. Solicit feedback from customers, including satisfaction surveys and input on product features.
  12. Identify expansion sales opportunities.

Requirements

The ideal candidate should be a master problem solver of hands-on technology, able to instill trust and confidence in their knowledge of the Appdome product and their ability to investigate and (re)solve technical hurdles to successfully deploying Appdome security inside mobile apps. This individual will guide customers through the process of using Appdome to secure their mobile apps and support them with answers to technical questions and help resolve conditions and incidents.

MUST HAVE :

  1. 5 Years of experience in customer support or technical support roles in a high-tech environment.
  2. Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field.
  3. Genuine desire to work with customers.
  4. Clear ability to instill trust and confidence with Customers, answering questions, resolving configuration options, etc.
  5. Skilled in SaaS, Pre-Sales, Software Documentation, and Information Security.
  6. Strong Analytical skills, with the ability to translate data into insights.
  7. Ability to capture, read and understand mobile device, network appliance, and other device or application logs showing network calls, APIs, system, application, or network errors, etc.
  8. Great communication and presentation skills.
  9. An expert at searching the web to look for solutions and information.
  10. Self-learner with a tenacious curiosity.
  11. Ability to prioritize tasks.
  12. Native or bilingual proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese.
  13. Full professional proficiency in English, written and verbal.
  14. Located in LATAM, preferred.

SHOULD HAVE / PREFERRED :

  1. Experience with Linux – Mac OS X.
  2. Professional proficiency in Spanish, written and verbal, a plus.
  3. BIG PLUS: Experience in mobile app development and frameworks (Android and iOS devices, dev environments for mobile apps), preferably with consumer-facing apps.

Company Overview

Appdome, the mobile app economy’s one-stop shop for mobile app defense, is on a mission to protect every mobile app in the world and the people who use mobile apps in their lives and at work. Appdome provides the mobile industry’s only mobile application Cyber Defense Automation platform, powered by a patented artificial-intelligence based coding engine, Threat-Events Threat-Aware UX/UI Control and ThreatScopeMobile XDR. Using Appdome, mobile brands eliminate complexity, save money, and deliver 300+ Certified Secure mobile app security, anti-malware, anti-fraud, MOBILEBotDefense, anti-cheat, MiTM attack prevention, code obfuscation, and other protections in Android and iOS apps with ease, all inside the mobile DevOps and CI/CD pipeline. Leading financial, healthcare, mobile games, government, and m-commerce brands use Appdome to protect Android and iOS apps, mobile customers, and mobile businesses globally. Today, Appdome's customers use the platform to secure over 50,000+ mobile apps and with protection of over 1B mobile end users.

title: Pre-Sales Data Scientist
description:
Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. That’s why we built the most complete cloud analytics and data platform for AI. By delivering harmonized data, trusted AI, and faster innovation, we uplift and empower our customers and our customers’ customers to make better, more confident decisions. The world’s top companies across every major industry trust Teradata to improve business performance, enrich customer experiences, and fully integrate data across the enterprise.

What You’ll Do

The Senior Data Scientist (pre-sales) is an experienced and expert Data Scientist, able to provide industry thought-leadership on Analytics and its application across industries and across use-cases. The Senior Data Scientist supports the account team in framing business problems and in identifying analytic solutions that leverage Teradata technology and that are disruptive, innovative - and above all, practical. An articulate and compelling communicator, the Senior Data Scientist establishes our position as an important partner for advanced analytics with customers and prospects and is a trusted advisor to executives, senior managers and fellow data scientists alike across a range of target accounts. They are also a hands-on practitioner who is ready, willing and able to roll-up her sleeves and to deliver POC and short-term pre-sales engagements. The Senior Data Scientist has an excellent theoretical and practical understanding of statistics and machine learning and has a strong track record of applying this understanding at scale to drive business benefit. They are insanely curious and is a natural problem-solver and able to effectively promote Teradata technology and solutions to our customers.

Who You’ll Work With

The successful candidate will work with other expert team members to:

  1. Provide pre-sales support at an executive level to the Teradata account teams, helping them to position and sell complex Analytic solutions that drive sales of Teradata software.
  2. Provide strategic pre-sales consulting to executives and senior managers in our target market.
  3. Support the delivery of PoC and PoV projects that demonstrate the viability and applicability of Analytic use-cases and the superiority of Teradata solutions and services.
  4. Work with the extended Account team, and Sales Analytics Specialists to develop new Analytic propositions that are aligned with industry trends and customer requirements.

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

  1. A degree level qualification (preferably Masters or PHD) in Statistics, Data Science, the physical or biological sciences or a related discipline.
  2. Have proven hands-on experience of complex analytics at scale for example in the areas of IoT and sensor data.
  3. Understand the PMML and ONNX model portability standards.
  4. Have experience with Teradata partner’s analytical products, Cloud Service providers such as AzureML and Sagemaker and partner products such as Dataiku and H2O.
  5. Have strong hands-on programming skills in at least one major analytic programming language and/or tool in addition to SQL.

What You’ll Bring

  1. An expertise in Data Science with a strong theoretical grounding in statistics, advanced analytics, and machine learning and at least 5 years real-world experience in the application of advanced analytics.
  2. A passion about knowledge sharing and demonstrate a commitment to continuous professional development.
  3. A belief in Teradata's Analytic solutions and services and be a commitment to working with the product, engineering, and consulting teams to ensure that they continue to lead the market.
  4. An ability to turn complex technical subject matter into relatable easy to digest and understand content for senior audiences.

Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. Quem somos

MISSÃO

A Carmen Steffens nasceu com o objetivo de oferecer às suas clientes produtos exclusivos, de alta qualidade, evidenciando o conceito de moda feminina no Brasil e no mundo.

VISÃO

A Carmen Steffens preocupa-se com a satisfação de cada cliente que busca itens únicos. Assim, lança peças exclusivas, 100% delas em fábrica própria, garantindo beleza, qualidade e conforto para seus consumidores.

VALORES

A Carmen Steffens valoriza e respeita o trabalho dos seus colaboradores, que fazem parte do dia a dia da marca. Na empresa, o convívio em harmonia e o bem-estar entre as pessoas estão refletidos nos produtos criativos da marca.

Com seu DNA de luxo e exclusividade, a Carmen Steffens se tornou uma das grifes mais conceituadas do Hemisfério Sul e uma referência no mundo da moda.

A grife, batizada com o nome da mãe do economista Mario Spaniol, nasceu na cidade de Franca, interior de São Paulo, em 1993, e atualmente conta com 560 lojas em 19 países.

A infraestrutura de produção da Carmen Steffens atende a todos os mercados em que a empresa está presente, iniciando pelo couro, em curtume próprio, passando por diversas etapas que incluem solados, saltos, palmilhas, até que o sapato, bolsa ou vestuário estejam prontos.

Além dos tradicionais sapatos e bolsas reconhecidos da grife, a marca também passou a produzir roupas, com uma fábrica em Criciúma, Santa Catarina, polo têxtil nacional, e lançou inúmeras lojas com seu novo conceito Maison.

A marca lança anualmente dez coleções e conta com estrelas internacionalmente reconhecidas, como a top brasileira Alessandra Ambrósio, para protagonizar suas campanhas.

No portfólio de marcas da grife, também encontra-se a linha masculina, Raphael Steffens, e a CS Club, lançada em 2015 e que já possui mais de 100 lojas no Brasil.

Eleita a melhor franquia de moda do Brasil em 2006 pela Fundação Getúlio Vargas, a Carmen Steffens é líder no mercado nacional e construiu uma sólida reputação global, graças à qualidade e design de seus produtos e a um modelo de negócios altamente rentável.

  3. Realizar treinamentos e desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe;
  4. Garantir a correta execução das estratégias comerciais no ponto de venda;
  5. Atuar diretamente com clientes, promovendo ações que impulsionam nosso relacionamento, eventos bem elaborados e networking;
  6. Realizar acompanhamento com os vendedores;
  7. Apoiar nas negociações comerciais e fechamento de vendas;
  8. Analisar a performance da equipe e elaborar planos de ação;
  9. Reportar resultados e desafios à supervisão e à diretoria comercial;
  10. Promover a cultura da empresa e garantir o cumprimento das políticas internas.

THIS IS A ON-SITE (NON-REMOTE) JOB AND DEMANDS ENGLISH PROFICIENCY

ESSA É UMA VAGA PRESENCIAL (NÃO-REMOTA) E EXIGE PROFICIÊNCIA EM INGLÊS

Our Game QA Testers are gaming experts who test video games during the initial development stage. Their job is to detect any bugs or glitches in the game before it goes on sale. They are required to complete all stages of a game, explore every map and level, focusing on identifying technical issues within a game, such as glitches, bugs, and inconsistencies.

To be one of our Game QA Testers, you should have in-depth knowledge of video game playthrough, have a real passion for gaming, and a good eye for detail. As a first step in the video game industry, you will be testing different titles on a variety of platforms.

Are you a gamer at heart? Are you a team player and is motivated to learn and grow? This is your opportunity to join the world leading company in video-games testing and contribute to the development lifecycle of some of the most popular games in the world!

No previous experience needed! We will help you learn the basic responsibilities of game testing, including playing multiple AAA games, detecting bugs and glitches, and recommending improvements. Our global team perform functionality and compliance checks on a range of yet-to-be-released games for a variety of platforms including PC, Xbox One, PS5, Switch, VR and mobile and tablet devices.

What you will be doing:

  • Testing games and software to find bugs and following test plans and checklists set by Test Leads to ensure the game functions correctly.
  • Report bugs into tracking database and re-test bugs once they’re fixed by developers by collaborating with colleagues, Senior Testers and Test Leads.
  • Report all glitches and bugs on the platform.
  • Communicating any issues to your Lead and recommending game additions or modifications.
  • Working as part of a global Games QA squad.
  • To love videogames !
  • Advanced proficiency in English (able to read, write, listen and speak ).
  • Availability to work from 10h00 to 19h00 (with 1 hour for lunch), from Mondays to Fridays.
  • 18+ years old
  • Great observational skills and attention to detail.
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft’s office suites.
  • Competitive remuneration.
  • Transportation allowance + Meal Voucher + Medical Assistance + Life Insurance + Private Pension
  • Dynamic, multicultural and fun environment.
  • You will be working for the world's leading provider of game services.
  • A supportive community inclusive of LGBTQ+, and any age, ethnicity, religion, or disability.
  • We care about the wellbeing of our employees and have a dedicated employee wellbeing program.
  • We empower our people and offer regular progression opportunities to ensure our employees flourish.

Who are we?

Side (formally known as PTW)is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world. Founded in Japan in 1994, Side has grown to become a global force in the video game industry, with over 40 studios in 15 countries worldwide and offices across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia.

Our industry-leading services include codev, art production, localization, audio production, quality assurance, localization QA, player support, community management, and datasets.

Help us bring stories to the world. Join Side's global team of passionate gamers and contribute to top-notch game development. Discover opportunities in Asia, North America, South America, Europe, and beyond.

We place a high degree of trust and responsibility in the hands of our engineers and expect them to deliver. We recognize that everyone can’t be a superstar in every area, so we are looking for people who have the required skills now and want to continue to learn.

    .

  • Coach a small team of junior data engineers (2 people).

  • Expert programming skills in Python/PySpark; experience in Java/Scala is beneficial.

  • Expertise in implementing Data Lake/Big Data projects in Cloud MS Azure and/or On-premise platforms.
  • Experience with designing and building lakehouse architectures in Parquet/Delta and Synapse Serverless or Databricks SQL.
  • Working experience with DevOps frameworks and a strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle.
  • Experience in performing root cause analysis on data and processes to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Ability to collaborate across different teams/geographies/stakeholders/levels of seniority.

  • Integração com Data Science: Trabalhar em parceria com o time de Data Science para projetar e implementar soluções baseadas em dados e Machine Learning.
  • Pipelines e processamento de dados: Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de ingestão, processamento e transformação de dados, garantindo qualidade, eficiência e governança.
  • Orquestração de Pipelines de Dados: Implementar e gerenciar workflows de dados utilizando ferramentas como Apache Airflow, garantindo a automação e escalabilidade dos processos de ingestão e processamento.
  • Melhores Práticas de DataOps: Aplicar conceitos de CI/CD para pipelines de dados, testes automatizados em ETLs, versionamento de dados e monitoramento contínuo da qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados.
  • Segurança e Governança de Dados: Garantir boas práticas de proteção de dados, controle de acessos, auditoria e conformidade com regulamentos como LGPD e GDPR.

  • Integração e APIs: Familiaridade com consumo e criação de APIs para manipulação e integração de dados.
  • Processamento e análise de dados em larga escala: Conhecimento em Data Warehousing e tecnologias de Big Data para lidar com grandes volumes de dados.
  • Documentação e suporte: Capacidade de criar e manter documentações claras e acessíveis para facilitar o uso dos recursos por outros usuários.
  • Gerenciamento de projetos: Experiência com organização e entregas de projetos de alta complexidade em engenharia de dados.
  • Cloud Computing: Experiência com provedores de nuvem, com foco em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e serviços como Cloud Functions, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow e Cloud Storage.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Data Science, incluindo bibliotecas e frameworks para modelagem e análise de dados.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas ERP, especialmente TOTVS, em contextos de integração de dados corporativos.

Company Overview

Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada.

Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.

#LI-Hybrid

Team Overview

A principal função da nossa equipe de vendas é desenvolver e expandir nosso portfólio de contas, garantindo que eles tenham um bom desempenho na plataforma 99.Através de um excelente atendimento ao cliente e de uma abordagem consultiva, o executivo de vendas deve estabelecer e manter relacionamentos comerciais bem-sucedidos e de longo prazo.

Role Responsibilities

  • O principal ponto de contato para nossos parceiros, garantindo uma comunicação próxima e contínua para gerar insights estratégicos, atender às suas necessidades e desenvolver planos de ação para crescimento e uma experiência aprimorada do usuário.
  • Analisando dados e desenvolvendo uma compreensão profunda da dinâmica do mercado e do comportamento dos parceiros para projetar, planejar e implementar estratégias comerciais destinadas a aumentar as vendas.
  • Construindo e promovendo relacionamentos de longo prazo baseados na confiança, com uma mentalidade ganha-ganha para garantir parcerias sustentáveis e mutuamente benéficas.

Role Qualifications

  • Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Relações Internacionais, ou áreas relacionadas.
  • 2+ anos de experiência em gestão de contas e vendas consultivas (a senioridade será avaliada ao longo do processo seletivo).
  • Capacidade e flexibilidade para se adaptar e aprender enquanto trabalha em um ambiente de startup em ritmo acelerado, com mudanças constantes e metas desafiadoras.
  • Habilidades interpessoais: Habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de persuadir e manter relações de trabalho construtivas, assertivas, colaborativas e cooperativas com clientes internos e externos em organizações multinacionais.
  • Habilidades analíticas: Capacidade de diagnosticar, compreender tendências de mercado e implementar planos de ação.
  • Senso de urgência e motivação para atingir objetivos enquanto analisa possíveis cenários.
  • Experiência em atingir e superar metas de vendas.
  • Conhecimento intermediário de Excel é um diferencial.

EEO Statement

  • Geramos Valor para os Usuários - Existimos para fazer o melhor para os nossos usuários e inovamos para estarmos sempre na frente. Buscamos o equilíbrio entre experiência, eficiência e crescimento, tendo a segurança sempre em primeiro lugar.
  • Somos Guiados por Dados - Acreditamos na tomada de decisão guiada por dados. Através dos números, navegamos em nosso negócio de forma estratégica.
  • Somos Donos e Focados nos Resultados - Vamos além dos interesses pessoais para focar no que é melhor para a DiDi. Sempre cumprimos o que prometemos e buscamos a excelência na execução, estabelecendo uma barra alta e dando o nosso máximo em tudo que fazemos.
  • Sempre Construímos Juntos - Juntos somos mais fortes. Temos a mente aberta e sempre remamos com respeito, empatia e confiança uns nos outros. Ouvimos a opinião de todos antes de tomar uma decisão e, quando decidimos algo, cumprimos o combinado juntos, mesmo se discordarmos.
  • Somos Íntegros - Integridade é a nossa base e a linha que nunca ultrapassamos. Comunicamos com honestidade, transparência e ouvimos a voz de todos para sempre fazer o que é certo.
  • Desenvolvemos uns aos Outros - Nosso crescimento vem da constante aventura de estarmos fora da nossa zona de conforto. Aceitamos desafios, nos superamos e trabalhamos em busca da excelência em tudo que fazemos. Desde o primeiro dia, nos desenvolvemos e ajudamos as pessoas ao nosso redor a crescerem também, elevando a nossa barra.
  • Trabalhamos com Paixão & Diversão - Somos completamente apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Mantemos um espírito leve e otimista, contagiando o nosso ambiente com energia positiva. Somos resilientes, não temos medo de enfrentar desafios e sempre celebramos nosso sucesso.
  • Vivemos a Diversidade - Para nós, o coração da diversidade é a inclusão, a igualdade e o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade promove um ambiente mais criativo e cheio de energia, por isso, celebramos as diferenças e aqui todos podem ser quem são.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Diversidade não é uma visão de futuro ou desejo de algo que queremos um dia, é um valor inegociável de quem somos hoje.

Vivemos a inclusão, a pluralidade e o respeito e, para isso, contamos com a governança do Comitê de Diversidade que atua junto com o RH, a nossa liderança e os grupos de identidade - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres e 99Famílias.

    • Ability to analyze operational needs and map them to technical solutions.
    • Strong critical thinking and troubleshooting abilities.
  • Project Management:

description:
ADP is hiring a Lead Quality Assurance Automation – Lyric Team

You will start your day with a scrum call to sync up the sprint work and goals with your team. Most of your day will be spent continuously evaluating existing test coverage, identifying gaps, and implementing test strategies to maximize confidence in automation and ensure product quality. Your role also involves advocating for necessary changes to improve the end-user experience.

In this role, you will collaborate with the development team and Product Owner to gather details on features to develop and use that information to build and execute product testing for ADP's web-based Human Resources solutions, ensuring usability before deployment. This role is critical to ensuring we deploy usable products.

Hybrid work model, reporting directly to our Porto Alegre Office location.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

Demonstrates advanced understanding and experience in:

  • Quality Assurance Analyst / Test Engineer
  • Selenium
  • Test Automation
  • Java, JavaScript/TypeScript
  • BDD/Cucumber
  • Jenkins
  • Writing Test Scenarios
  • Using API testing
  • Testing web UI and API applications
  • Working with Continuous Integration processes and tools like Jenkins

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • Agile. You understand that an agile environment requires flexibility. Sometimes the scope is not fully defined, and you'll need to communicate with the Product Owner and team to gather more details and refine User Stories. You and the team will define the sprint goal together. Working in two-week sprints, you need to adhere to timelines. Due to time constraints and work fluidity, you may need to take a creative approach to testing strategies. Starting test development in parallel with feature development may be an option.
  • Create & Test. You'll define test plans and scenarios and implement automated test cases for large-scale, complex software applications, focusing on verification and validation from a system and end-user perspective.
  • Collaborate. You will communicate and collaborate with developers and stakeholders, articulating clear reasons to persuade for product improvements benefiting the end user.
  • Learning. You are eager to learn new coding skills and figure things out as you go.
  • Challenges. You will encounter challenges and will be expected to find solutions.

What are you waiting for? Apply today!

*The work model adopted by ADP is office-based/presential, with the possibility of up to two days of remote work per week.

Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras globais de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos, guiados por nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho, incluindo ética, integridade, humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Descrição da vaga

  1. Liderar o Processo de Implementação da Política de Segurança dos Processos na CIA

Desenvolver planos de implementação para atender aos padrões do programa PSP 2.0, incluindo:

  • Conformidade com o PSM da OSHA (29 CFR 1910.119);
  • Regulamentações locais de PSM + LDC PSP 2.0 para a prevenção de acidentes graves (eventos de magnitude significativa, como incêndios, explosões, derramamentos que podem causar fatalidades, impactar a mídia ou a reputação da empresa).

Garantir que as informações de segurança do processo (P&IDs, normas técnicas) sejam mantidas atualizadas, bem como as PHAs e suas conexões lógicas com o restante dos elementos do PSM e a tecnologia necessária para garantir operações seguras.

Fornecer suporte direto aos locais de fabricação sobre questões operacionais, sistemas ambientais e melhores práticas para implementação.

Qualificações

  • Graduação em engenharia ou áreas afins, com pós-graduação em Segurança de Processos.
  • Familiaridade com estudos de análise de riscos de processos (PHA), técnicas de gerenciamento de projetos, revisões pré-embarque (PSSR), gerenciamento de mudanças (MOC) e gerenciamento de contratados.
  • Conhecimento de planejamento, atividades de design, engenharia de projetos, operações e manutenção. Fluência em inglês. Conhecimento em softwares de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Experiência com instalações industriais com risco químico, gerenciamento de poeira em cereais, gás e petróleo ou riscos equivalentes, preferencialmente com foco na aplicação de um programa PSM.

Informações adicionais

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Esta oportunidade também é destinada a pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro do nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados por criar valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para os stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nossos colaboradores, parceiros comerciais, comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

As a GRC Sr Analyst – Policy Governance, you will be a key player in developing, implementing, and maintaining organizational governance frameworks and policies. You'll ensure compliance with internal regulations and external requirements, mitigate risks, and facilitate informed decision-making. This role requires a deep understanding of policy development, compliance monitoring, risk assessment, and stakeholder management.   • Develop, implement, and maintain organizational governance frameworks and policies.

  • Knowledge of governance frameworks, risk management, and compliance best practices.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Familiarity with online governance systems is a plus.
  • English fluent or in advanced level.

description:

Everything we do for our clients comes down to having the right business and technical knowledge, as well as leadership for every occasion. Our colleagues across the business look to our Talent Attraction & Acquisition (TA2) team to consistently provide the most promising talent to our world-class organization. As a Talent Attraction Manager, Assistant Director, you will be at the heart of that goal, directly engaging with business leaders, colleagues, and candidates from a diverse array of backgrounds.

The Opportunity

As a Talent Attraction Manager, Assistant Director, you will oversee a dynamic team of Talent Attraction Recruiters, driving our mission to attract and retain the best talent for our organization. You will play a critical role in shaping our recruitment strategies, enhancing our candidate experience, and ensuring that our team operates at the highest level of efficiency and effectiveness. Your leadership will be essential in fostering a collaborative environment that empowers team members to excel and innovate.

Your Key Responsibilities

  1. Manage and mentor a team of Talent Attraction Recruiters, providing guidance, support, and professional development opportunities to enhance their skills and performance.
  2. Manage employee performance, recognition and ensure team and individual KPIs are met.
  3. Develop and implement comprehensive recruitment strategies to attract contractors, students and experienced hires, ensuring alignment with EY's business goals and service line needs.
  4. Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including business leaders and hiring managers, to understand their talent needs and deliver tailored recruitment solutions.
  5. Oversee talent pipeline process, collaborating with team members to identify top candidates and convert prospects into active applicants.
  6. Help drive the sourcing strategy to identify and attract diverse talent, ensuring the use of inclusive initiatives and creative sourcing techniques.
  7. Ensure a seamless and exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment process, reinforcing EY's reputation for quality and innovation.
  8. Act as a change agent for new technologies, tools, and processes, facilitating their adoption within the recruiting community.
  9. Stay informed about talent and labor market trends, ensuring all recruiting activities comply with local legal and organizational policies and regulations.
  10. Leverage analytics and AI tools to gain insights into recruitment trends, candidate behaviors, and market demands, making informed decisions to optimize recruitment efforts.
  11. Work with Talent Attraction leadership to deploy resources toward business priorities.
  12. Demonstrate initiative and self-motivation by serving as an individual contributor when needed, driving project success while collaborating with the team.

To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have:

  1. Minimum 8 years of experience in recruiting and/or sourcing within professional or financial services, corporate, or agency environments.
  2. Proven experience in leading and managing recruitment teams, with a strong focus on performance and development.
  3. Demonstrated knowledge and prior experience in attracting and engaging contractors, students and experienced hires using a variety of recruitment resources.
  4. Strong strategic-thinking skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders on best practices.
  5. Consultative approach to client relationships, serving as a trusted talent advisor on the external candidate pipeline.
  6. Expertise in creative sourcing techniques and a solid understanding of IT and technology-related roles.
  7. Ability to adhere to Service Level Agreements (SLA) of 24-48 hours for delivering sourced candidate profiles to hiring teams.
  8. Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and experience with applicant tracking software; willingness to learn AI-driven tools and platforms.
  9. Experience working with North American talent markets in a professional services context.
  10. Capacity to thrive in a fast-paced environment with multiple concurrent projects.
  11. Strong reporting and data analytical skills.
  12. A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferred.
  13. Fluency in English, both verbal and written.

Why Join EY?

At EY, we are committed to building a better working world. In this leadership role, you will have the opportunity to help drive EY's talent acquisition efforts, guiding your team to attract the best candidates who align with our values and contribute to our success. You will be supported by a network of knowledgeable colleagues and have the chance to shape the future of our recruitment strategies in a dynamic and innovative environment. You will work across multiple functions, collaborate with diverse teams, and make a significant impact on EY’s success.

Join us in our mission to attract and engage the best talent in the industry!

title: Competitive Intelligence Specialist
description:
The Competitive Intelligence Specialist is part of the sales team. Be prepared to work with the sales force to help win the deal. You will be THE expert on your competitor(s) and solely responsible for all insights and understanding of a competitor set and that responsibility does not end with educating the sales force on the competitor. You need to be prepared to present NetSuite vs. competitor X to our prospect, our partners and our systems integrators. You will be asked to compare our product with our competitor and answer deep functional differentiator questions. You will develop client-facing content and travel to client, prospect, partner and systems integrator meetings to add your knowledge and insight. While you will be building reusable content, the focus of this role is in support of deals which includes being comfortable with prospect and customer facing meetings and events.

You are also responsible for a vertical or horizontal business unit's market, competitor and customer insight needs. This includes providing insight support by using all primary and secondary resources available. You are considered a member of the sales force you support and will regularly be asked to participate in staff meetings, group sessions, deal reviews, partner interactions and client-facing competitor reviews. You own the win/loss review process and that includes interviewing the prospects and customers on why we won/lost and bringing that knowledge to bear in future sales cycles.

To do this you should have mastered all standard secondary resource tools and must be adept at engaging in primary research utilizing proven, validated research techniques. You will be seen as an expert in your area of responsibility and will regularly be asked for recommendations or opinions.

Career Level - IC4

Responsibilities

  1. Sales Lifecycle skills: Engages throughout the entire lifecycle of the deal from the initial “attract” phase through “close” providing content, collateral, talking points, FUD, traps, win themes, differentiators, and pricing strategy to beat the competitor. Support can take many forms including coaching the sales force to presenting directly to the prospect.
  2. Insight Generation skills: Proactively seeks additional analyses to flesh out findings. Integrates interesting patterns into a cohesive story. Maintains relationships with SMEs within the company and outside who can help with insight generation. Consistently informs research recommendations with a personal point of view. Uses professional experience to develop their own and their colleague’s recommendations. Consistently develops compelling "so what’s" and actionable "now what’s" for the business.
  3. Business problem solving skills: Reframes requests to maximize their value even when the requests come from difficult constituents. Continues the scoping conversation throughout the project process to test interim findings/insights with the business partner. Is recognized by senior business partners for possessing exceptional business acumen and is proactively sought for advice. Captures opportunities to influence business decisions and strategies consistently.
  4. Influencing skills: Focuses on relationship building as well as using strong scoping tools to uncover the problem even when not clearly articulated. Encourages debate around research recommendations and consistently advocates for their point of view.
  5. Communication skills: Capable of presenting point of view. Owns the building and constant updating of relationship maps to understand the appropriate constituents to focus on. Creates presentations that focus on the insights that are clearly articulated with supporting data where appropriate. Leverages knowledge management tools or research communications to share insights broadly across the organization, with a particular focus on vertical and industry communities. Considers communication preferences and decision maker needs to tailor recommendation communication across audiences. Presents at Voice of the Analyst events (when applicable) and/or other meetings.
  6. Synthesis skills: Takes ownership for stewarding the research team's knowledge base by continuously maintaining platforms on KM and/or collaboration platforms and other loci of knowledge. Works with business partners to compile current knowledge and identifies gaps that they need filled in order to make better decisions. Considered a valuable team member outside the research organization for their ability to compile and make sense of diverse data.
  7. Foundational skills: Seeks information on new techniques through conferences or other learning sources. Proposes new/different research techniques. Actively seeks out training in emerging methods and techniques. Seeks out sources and learning events to grow business acumen and industry knowledge.

title: Mechanical Designer
description:
Description

This is a full-time, onsite, hourly position at our Bethlehem, PA facility.

Company Background:

ABEC is a leading supplier to the biopharmaceutical manufacturing industry. ABEC's unique value is based on combining long experience with the ability to engineer, design, manufacture, commission, qualify, and service the entire bioprocess to reduce overall cost, shorten time to market, and maximize productivity. ABEC's products include process and equipment engineering/consulting services, comprehensive site services, bioreactors and fermenters, filtration and chromatography systems, prep and hold systems, and cleaning/sterilization systems.

Benefits include:

  • Paid holidays and vacation time
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance (benefits start day 1)
  • Company paid life insurance
  • Generous 401K plan (40% match)
  • College tuition benefit program
  • Employee Referral Program

Position Summary:

The Mechanical Designer works under the direction of the Design Team Leader and utilizes independent judgment to perform the day-to-day project duties of designing, developing and releasing deliverables. This includes detail & assembly drawings and related bills-of-material used in the fabrication of equipment for pilot and commercial scale biopharmaceutical manufacturing (largely pressure vessel assemblies for fluid & gas handling and motorized agitation systems). Primary responsibility involves generating design plans utilizing Autodesk Inventor and AutoCAD software. This position requires a high level of attention to detail along with the ability to develop a strong understanding of the ASME/ BPE Bioprocessing Equipment design standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Ability to work in a professional team-based office environment and meet date-driven customer-focused commitments.
  • Review and comprehend customer generated specifications and requirements.
  • Design and maintain documents with technical support from project engineering and project management.
  • Create / maintain component BOM documentation.
  • Create / maintain piping arrangement drawings (Top assembly and Piping module) using P&ID and customer specifications consisting of however not limited to, 3D models, detail drawings, spool drawings & bill of materials.
  • Create / maintain agitation system designs.
  • Generate Engineering Change Notices (ECN’s).
  • Create and maintain project files using departmental resources and best practices.
  • Conduct model design reviews with both internal resources as well as externally with customers and project management.
  • Record needed changes during design review processes and ensure they are communicated to the project team using departmental resources / best practices.
  • Provide manufacturing support related to published designs and released design documentation as required.
  • Generate “as-built” design documentation and provide to the Quality department as needed.
  • Will play an active role in identifying and driving Continuous Improvement (CI) opportunity.
  • Execute other tasks as assigned.
  • Ability to travel when required.

Qualifications:

  • Associates Degree in Computer Aided Design and Drafting or equivalent.
  • 1 year post graduate in drafting and design.
  • Knowledge of 3D Parametric CAD.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office applications; including Word and Excel.
  • Detail oriented with a solid understanding of drafting standards, design fundamentals, and related fabrication processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Good organizational skills with the ability to multi-task.
  • Must work well both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Responsible for creating and maintaining piping arrangement drawings (Top assembly and Piping module) with 3D models, spool drawings & bill of materials.
  • Generate Engineering Change Notices (ECN’s) used to properly document and publish control changes made to Design documentation as specified in company procedures, work instructions and best practices.
  • Domestic and international travel is required.
  • Awareness of and prior experience with implementing Continuous Improvement (CI) a plus.
  • Prior Lean/Six Sigma experience a plus.
  • Other work as assigned to support projects and/or customer expectations as needed.

Other Preferred Requirements:

  • Demonstrated ability to carry a project from conception to production.
  • 1-2 years in a related industry using 3D parametric CAD-based software with direct experience processing ECN’s, BOM’s and other related design documentation.
  • Prior experience using Autodesk Inventor and/or Routed Systems.
  • Prior experience using Autodesk AutoCAD 2D/3D.
  • Experience with ERP software for item and bill-of-material creation; Syteline preferred.
  • Experience with ASME/BPE Bioprocessing Equipment standards.
  • Awareness of and prior experience with implementing Continuous Improvement (CI) a plus.
  • Prior Lean/Six Sigma experience a plus.

title: Accounting Associate
description:
Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for an Accounting Associate!

Note to Applicants:

  • Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
  • Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.

About the Role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Accounting Associate to join our growing offshore team. The ideal candidate will assist in managing financial records, processing transactions, and supporting accounting functions to ensure smooth financial operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Accounts Payable:
    • The associate would be responsible for managing client email inboxes, including vendor information, responding to vendor emails, and coding invoices in the client’s accounts payable software daily. They would also prepare AP run files weekly.
  • Accounts Receivable:
    • Depending on the client, the associate would be responsible for preparing customer emails, sending collection follow-up emails, and preparing AR aging summaries.
  • Month End Close:
    • The associate will be working on 5-7 clients depending on their size, preparing month-end tasks concurrently during the first 10-15 business days of the month.
    • Tasks include bank and credit card reconciliations, prepaid expenses, fixed assets, accounts payable and receivable reconciliations. As they gain experience, tasks can evolve in complexity, including payroll, accruals, revenue, and preparing financial statement packages and flux analysis.
  • Audit / Tax Requests:
    • As clients file annual tax returns or grow to need audits, associates will assist in preparing schedules needed to support these processes.

Requirements:

  • Strong preference for a degree in Accounting, with Finance or related fields being secondary.
  • If they have a degree in a related field, an accounting certification would be a plus.

Must Haves:

  • Full professional proficiency, both spoken and written. Effective communication is imperative.
  • 2 to 5 years of experience in an accounting or bookkeeping role, preferably with a US-based company.
  • Experience preparing bank reconciliations, fixed assets, prepaid expenses, etc.
  • Experience with Quickbooks Online is a large bonus.

Nice to Haves:

  • Work experience at one of the big four US accounting firms (KPMG, PricewaterhouseCoopers, Deloitte, Ernst & Young).
  • Ability to create or improve processes in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Experience in Netsuite, Bill.com and/or Ramp.

Work Schedule:

Typically, the associate’s schedule would be 9AM - 6PM EST, with flexibility to shift that window an hour either way.

Perks:

  • Competitive USD compensation.
  • PTO Policy in addition to US Holiday Schedule.
  • Opportunity to work in a dynamic and growing company.
  • Positive and collaborative work environment.

If this opportunity sounds good to you, send us your resume!

description:
Hogarth - The Global Content Experience Company

Part of WPP, Hogarth partners with one in every two of the world’s top 100 brands, including Coca-Cola, Ford, Rolex, Nestlé, Mondelez, and Dyson. With extensive experience across various sectors, Hogarth delivers relevant, engaging, and measurable content across all channels and media—both established and emerging. Our global team of over 7,500 craft and technology experts combines creativity, production, and innovation to help clients navigate today’s dynamic content landscape.

WPP is the creative transformation company, leveraging the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients, and communities. Working at WPP means joining a global network of over 100,000 talented individuals dedicated to extraordinary work across more than 100 countries, with headquarters in New York, London, and Singapore.

WPP leads in marketing services, with capabilities in AI, data, technology, and creative talent. Our clients include many Fortune Global 500 companies. We are committed to a culture of creativity, belonging, and continuous learning, providing exciting career growth opportunities.

We believe the best work happens when we collaborate in person, fostering creativity and connection. Our hybrid model involves teams working in the office around four days a week. Please discuss any accommodations or flexibility needs with the hiring team during the interview process.

The Role

We seek a people-centric leader with a strong background in language services to manage and support a distributed team delivering high-quality transcreation projects. You will serve as a mentor and escalation point, ensuring team productivity, morale, and adherence to workflows. Your leadership will be vital in aligning operations with client expectations and meeting KPIs. You will work closely with cross-functional teams and clients to monitor performance, identify improvements, and support professional development, balancing team management with operational oversight to ensure efficiency, quality, and client satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Mentor and support your team, managing workload and resources to maintain productivity and morale.
  • Ensure adherence to language workflows and processes to meet quality and consistency standards.
  • Build strong client relationships as a Languages and Localisation SME, guiding them through workflows and meeting SLAs and KPIs.
  • Conduct strategic reviews, presentations, and reporting to ensure objectives are met and workload is visible for planning.
  • Assist in cost estimation, budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting; identify new revenue opportunities.
  • Coach and develop your team, supporting their Personal Development Plans, performance management, and training needs.
  • Promote team utilization and cross-training opportunities.
  • Collaborate effectively with Talent Management, Quality Management, Client Services, and Production teams within Hogarth.
  • Understand Hogarth’s business model, services, and technologies; identify workflow improvements to maximize efficiency and profitability.
  • Support recruitment and interview processes as needed.

Reporting Lines and Key Stakeholders

  • This role reports to the Director of Language Services.
  • Collaborate with other Language Services team members in London, working with global accounts and teams in Mexico, Argentina, and Canada.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in language services (Translation, Transcreation, Cultural Insight, Linguistic AI).
  • 2+ years of team management experience, both locally and virtually.
  • Financial skills including P&L, estimating, budgeting, forecasting.
  • Experience with TMS and CAT tools.
  • Proven end-to-end language project management skills.
  • Exceptional communication skills for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and problem-solving skills; ability to work under pressure.
  • Client management skills and a strong professional network.
  • Ability to follow established processes and challenge the status quo.
  • Fluent in English (oral and written) plus additional languages.

Há mais de 20 anos no Brasil, com o propósito de alimentar o mundo, somos uma multinacional francesa que fabrica e comercializa soluções altamente tecnológicas para nutrição das plantas e dos animais.

Pertencemos ao Grupo Roullier, que está presente em todos os continentes, com comercialização em 131 países, 97 plantas industriais e mais de 8500 colaboradores.

Nossas soluções são desenvolvidas por mais de uma centena de pesquisadores junto ao Centro Mundial de Inovação - CMI na França. No Brasil, contamos com três plantas industriais de fertilizantes sólidos nas cidades de Candeias (BA), Santa Luzia do Norte (AL) e em Rio Grande (RS), na qual também está unidade de produção de fertilizantes líquidos e uma moderna fábrica voltada exclusivamente para nutrição animal.

  • Atender e gerir carteira de clientes;

title: Analista Comercial Junior
description:
O Analista Comercial é um profissional que trabalha no suporte às operações comerciais, ajudando a equipe comercial a alcançar os objetivos da empresa. Sua principal função é analisar e processar dados, gerenciar informações sobre o mercado e clientes, além de fornecer suporte estratégico para a tomada de decisões dentro da área comercial. Esse cargo exige habilidades analíticas, organizacionais e de comunicação, além de um bom entendimento dos processos comerciais.
Principais responsabilidades:

  • Análise de Mercado e Desempenho Comercial:
    • Coletar, processar e analisar dados de vendas, tendências de mercado, concorrência e comportamento dos clientes.
    • Gerar relatórios periódicos para monitorar o desempenho das vendas, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e sugerir ações estratégicas.
    • Realizar a análise de indicadores comerciais (KPIs), como taxa de conversão, ticket médio, ciclo de vendas, entre outros.
  • Suporte na Planejamento Comercial:
    • Apoiar na elaboração de planos e estratégias comerciais, colaborando com as equipes de vendas e marketing.
    • Ajudar a definir metas de vendas, estratégias de precificação e segmentação de mercado.
    • Acompanhar a execução das estratégias e reportar resultados e desvios aos gestores.
  • Gestão de Relacionamento com Clientes:
    • Apoiar a equipe comercial na identificação de clientes potenciais e manter o banco de dados de clientes atualizado.
    • Auxiliar na manutenção do relacionamento com os clientes através de ferramentas de CRM (Customer Relationship Management).
    • Apoiar no desenvolvimento de propostas comerciais e no processo de negociação.
  • Processamento e Controle de Pedidos e Contratos:
    • Ajudar na elaboração e controle de pedidos de vendas, contratos e orçamentos, garantindo que os processos sejam feitos corretamente.
    • Monitorar o andamento dos pedidos e garantir que as entregas e o processo de faturamento sejam realizados de maneira eficiente.
  • Monitoramento de Competência e Mercado:
    • Realizar pesquisas sobre as tendências do mercado, comportamento dos consumidores e concorrência para fornecer informações cruciais à estratégia comercial.
    • Auxiliar na análise da performance de produtos e serviços da empresa em comparação com os oferecidos pelos concorrentes.
  • Apoio à Equipe Comercial:
    • Fornecer suporte operacional à equipe de vendas, seja com informações sobre clientes, produtos, preços ou demais dados necessários para a prospecção de novos negócios.
    • Preparar apresentações comerciais e materiais de apoio para reuniões com clientes ou reuniões internas.

Nos últimos anos, muitas empresas chegaram para completar o ecossistema e nossa expertise cresceu, oferecendo mais possibilidades de conexões para atender grandes empresas e alguns de nossos produtos foram direcionados para solucionar questões mais complexas, foi aí que surgiu o segmentoWake , com o objetivo de pensar na jornada dos clientes, de uma maneira muito mais fluída e com integrações consistentes.

Por aqui, cultivamos um espaço inclusivo e diverso e temos a sustentabilidade em nosso DNA. Juntos estamos construindo um futuro sustentável para nossos negócios, colaboradores e sociedade.

Buscamos pessoas extraordinárias para completar nosso time, que tenham atitude, agilidade e criatividade para inovar e desenvolver negócios que transformam o mundo.

Estamos em busca de um Analista Sr. de Inteligência de Mercado para atuar no time de Product Marketing da Wake , com foco em SaaS B2B. Essa pessoa será responsável por consolidar nossa inteligência de mercado e fortalecer nossa capacidade de entender e captar prospects de forma estratégica. Sua principal missão será aprofundar o conhecimento sobre nosso mercado endereçável, definindo com precisão nosso ICP (Ideal Customer Profile) e compreendendo as dores e os stakeholders decisores de cada segmento. Isso envolve analisar a base atual de clientes e prospects por segmento, tier e comportamento de compra, oferecendo insumos valiosos para orientar nossas estratégias de conteúdo, growth e posicionamento. Também terá papel ativo no monitoramento contínuo da concorrência, identificando riscos e oportunidades de diferenciação. Procuramos alguém com perfil analítico, investigativo e com forte orientação a negócios, capaz de transformar dados em decisões práticas para os times de produto, marketing e vendas


Main responsibilities

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Coleta e Análise de Dados de Mercado:
  • Realizar pesquisas de mercado para entender tendências, demandas dos clientes e o cenário competitivo
  • Analisar dados de mercado e transformar insights em recomendações acionáveis.
  • Monitoramento da Concorrência:
  • Acompanhar as atividades dos concorrentes, incluindo novos produtos, estratégias de marketing, preços e posicionamento.
  • Elaborar relatórios comparativos e análises SWOT (Forças, Fraquezas, Oportunidades, Ameaças).
  • Análise de Clientes e Segmentação:
  • Identificar e analisar diferentes segmentos de clientes e suas necessidades específicas das diferentes verticais do ecossistema de produtos Wake.
  • Realizar estudos de comportamento do cliente e satisfação.
  • Suporte à Estratégia de Produto:
  • Colaborar com equipes de produto para fornecer insights sobre necessidades do mercado e oportunidades de desenvolvimento de novos produtos.
  • Ajudar na definição do posicionamento de produtos e mensagens-chave.
  • Desenvolvimento de Go-to-Market Strategies:
  • Contribuir para a criação de estratégias de entrada no mercado e lançamentos de novos produtos.
  • Trabalhar com equipes de vendas e marketing para garantir uma implementação eficaz das estratégias.
  • Mensuração e Relatórios de Desempenho:
  • Desenvolver métricas e KPIs para medir o desempenho de campanhas de marketing e iniciativas de produto.
  • Gerar relatórios periódicos de evolução de mercado endereçável

A Ajinomoto, é uma multinacional japonesa com sede em Tóquio, referência mundial na produção de Aminoácidos. Atualmente, está presente em 35 países, possuindo 121 fábricas e mais de 32 mil funcionários em todo o mundo.

Nossos aminoácidos são utilizados como matéria-prima em diversos segmentos, como: Indústrias alimentícia, cosmética, farmacêutica, nutrição animal e agronegócio.

No Brasil, a Ajinomoto chegou em 1956 e hoje o país é o 3º mercado mais importante do Grupo Ajinomoto fora do Japão, atrás apenas da Tailândia e dos EUA. Possui sede administrativa em São Paulo e quatro unidades fabris no interior de São Paulo, localizadas nas cidades de Limeira, Laranjal Paulista, Valparaíso e Pederneiras. A companhia também atua no segmento de Food Service, contribuindo de forma estratégica e parceira, com os mais diversos estabelecimentos que fornecem alimentação fora do lar.

A nossa cultura é focada na criação de novos valores, no espírito empreendedor, na contribuição plena com a sociedade e na valorização das pessoas. A Ajinomoto busca sempre o melhor para seus parceiros, funcionários e clientes, por isso estamos sempre em busca de novos talentos que busquem desenvolvimento e estejam dispostos a crescer juntos com a gente.

Venha fazer parte desse time e contribuir para a construção de um futuro melhor!

title: Bid Manager (Coordenador Senior de Propostas)
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the Bid Manager in São Paulo we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your expertise in bids and signalling systems to a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative, innovative, and goal-oriented teammates.

You'll play a key role in driving successful bid management processes, ensuring alignment with customer expectations and Alstom’s strategic goals. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (engineering, finance, legal, and procurement), manage risk assessments, and ensure adherence to deadlines, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of leading national and international bids and developing strategies for the transportation and information markets, but also liaise with multicultural and matrix teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

We’ll look to you for:

  • Managing bids for signalling systems in the rail market

  • Ensuring alignment with customer expectations, technology breakthroughs, and competitive landscapes

  • Driving financial results and ensuring cost-effective solutions

  • Conducting risk analysis (financial, legal, and political) and implementing mitigation strategies

  • Collaborating with internal and external partners to motivate and achieve results

  • Ensuring adherence to deadlines while maintaining quality and rigor


All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

  • Engineering Degree (Master equivalent or above) in Telecom, Electrical, Electronics, or Automation

  • More than 8 years of experience as a bid manager

  • Experience in signalling systems within the rail market

  • Knowledge of transportation and information markets, including customer expectations and business models

  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills

  • Experience in risk analysis methods

  • Understanding of technical/engineering issues, contracting, finance, and product specifications

  • Fluency in English; Spanish advanced

  • Effective active listening, communication, and negotiation skills

  • Ability to work in a multi-cultural and matrix organization

  • Focus on simple solutions to complex problems

  • Strong process orientation and financial result-driven mindset


Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

  • Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career

  • Work with advanced security standards for rail signalling

  • Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues

  • Contribute to innovative projects

  • Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment

  • Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries

  • Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning

  • Progress towards senior leadership roles

  • Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.
